target.statement: SOC (Video-Swin-T, trained from scratch) achieves 59.2 J&F on Ref-YouTube-VOS

compute.basis: Training requires 8x32GB V100 GPUs for 30 epochs on Ref-YouTube-VOS (3978 videos), which is infeasible on a CPU-only laptop; even with a single GPU it would take days.

blockers: No code released (paper says 'Code will be available')
Large-scale video dataset and long training schedule
title: SOC: Semantic-Assisted Object Cluster for Referring Video Object Segmentation
